headline: Arm and AMD Fall 5% as Qualcomm Verdict Adds to Chip Selloff; Taiwan Semiconductor Slips
summary: A Delaware jury just handed Arm a damaging verdict in its licensing battle with Qualcomm, and with a second ruling on its newest chip designs due next week, the pressure on the entire semiconductor sector may only be getting started.

headline: The Buying Opportunities Hidden in the Chip Stock Chaos
summary: Few, if any, chip names have been left unscathed from the brutal selloff. But it's a chance to hunt for bargains.

headline: The Next AI Stock Wall Street Is Starting to Pay Attention To
summary: Arm Holdings has surged over 120% this year while building a chip empire that stretches from smartphones into AI data centers, but a brutal recent selloff and a valuation that makes even NVIDIA look cheap raise a pointed question about how much further this story can run.

headline: How Much Upside Is Left In Micron Stock?
summary: Shares of Micron Technology (MU) returned 398.4% in the year to October 15, 2026. The S&P 500 returned 17.9% over the same period. Investors holding the stock after that run want to know if the easy money is gone. Those watching from the sidelines wonder if they are too late. So what could three more years of owning Micron still make you.

headline: Is AMD Stock Safer Or Riskier Than A Year Ago?
summary: Investors holding Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) stock have enjoyed a very good year: shares returned 157.8% over the past year, compared with a 17.9% gain for the S&P 500. A return of that magnitude prompts a closer look at the underlying business, and the company's financial report for the quarter ended June 27, 2026, provides the latest view into its accounts. Has the company taken on more risk to get there.

headline: AI planned a crime and exposed it
summary: In the Loop host Ejaaz Ahamadeen unpacks allegations of corporate espionage inside OpenAI (OPAI.PVT), examining what sparked the controversy, the key players involved and how the AI exposed and helped resolve it.

headline: How an OpenAI model caught a spy inside its HQ
summary: Host Ejaaz Ahamadeen walks through how a $24 listening device, a digital trail of chatbot queries, and an internal OpenAI model led to a spy-movie style arrest.

headline: What's Going On With Arm Stock Friday?
summary: Arm Holdings (ARM) stock loses momentum as investors weigh a legal setback, lofty valuation and profit-taking after a massive rally.
